name: v1.0.1 (2026-11-01)
body:
### Fixes
- Fixed local instance creator to work offline with local images. #387
  Local instance creator previously checked Docker registry for tag validity, which would fail in an offline environment. Now the creator checks the tag locally first, against available images.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1

name: v1.0.0 (2026-09-30)
body: 1.0, wow! 🎉 Thank you for using the app and for your ongoing support. Thank you to contributors, to those answering questions about Penpot Desktop all around the Internet, to maintainers of alternative packages and installers, and to those working on upstream dependencies. Let's keep going. The new ideas are plenty and Penpot Desktop will be even better. If your company or organisation would like to support my open source activity, including this project, please contact me at belar@authormore.com. Onto the changes! > This is a major release and it includes breaking changes. Look for the ⚠️ sign below to see if you need to act. ### Features - ⚠️ [BREAKING CHANGE] Added local instance resources clean-up on deletion. #370 Local instance’s Docker resources will now be deleted as part of the instance removal. That includes ALL of the instance’s containers, networks, and volumes. The action cannot be undone. Back up your data before deletion. If you were removing instances through the Penpot Desktop’s UI and then deleting resources with e.g. Docker Desktop, there is no need to do that anymore. - Added instance removal confirmation. #370 Instance removal flow now features a confirmation dialog. In case of a remote instance, it’s an extra click. For a local instance, where all the content is at stake, you will be required to type in the instance’s name as a deletion confirmation. ### Fixes - Fixed dev tools to open for the application’s window. #352 Dev tools toggle, `cmd/ctrl + shift + i`, now correctly opens dev tools of the application, not the currently focused tab. - Fixed abandoned partitions to be cleaned up. #363 The app will now check for abandoned partitions (e.g. for instances removed manually from the configuration file(s)) and move them to the bin/trash. The check happens automatically on launch. - Fixed derived instance content to be saved. #363 Instance’s defaults and normalisation were applied after a config read, but not saved until e.g. after an instance setting edit. It included instance id, which could be generated on every launch and change an instance to a new partition. It could result in a build-up of unused partitions. If your installation was affected and accumulated such partitions, v1.0.0 includes (mentioned earlier) an abandoned partition clean-up. The removed partitions will show up in the bin/trash. - [macOS] Fixed top bar to fade when window is not focused. #365 - Fixed batch export error to be handled. #366 - Fixed batch download button to be present on launch. #367 - Fixed instance to use valid origin. #368 - Fixed the app to force single instance. #372 Penpot Desktop doesn’t support running multiple copies of the application, which could result in broken configuration. The application will now prevent additional copies from starting and point to the already running copy. ### Removed - ⚠️ [BREAKING CHANGE] Removed elevated access mode for instance creator. #355 Starting with this release, local instances require Docker to be able to run unprivileged on the host. For example, Docker Desktop and [Rootless mode](https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/rootless/) allow you to run Docker without elevated access. If you created an instance using the elevated access option, you will need to switch to an unprivileged solution in order to perform updates or deletion from Penpot Desktop. - ⚠️ [BREAKING CHANGE] Removed configurations’ migrations. #356 Migrations (transformers) in configuration parsers provided a way to apply breaking fixes without requiring everyone affected to manually fix a config file. Now that the migrations have been in place long enough to correct the majority of configurations, they have been removed to not accumulate workarounds in the parsers. If you last ran v0.13.1 or older, I recommend first installing v0.25.0 and then updating to v1.0.0 - manually or letting the auto-updater do it. ### Security - ⚠️ [BREAKING CHANGE] Added limit for local instance’s network availability. #359 The official Docker Compose configuration binds a self-hosted Penpot instance to all interfaces (`0.0.0.0`), which makes it available on a local network. Considering the intention of the local instance installation, “an offline Penpot”, the binding was changed to the loopback (`127.0.0.1`) and local instances are now only available to their machine. If you rely on this setup, after an instance update, you will need to open the instance to the local network on your own e.g. via forwarding. Keep in mind the setup is designed around “offline Penpot instance” e.g. with disabled email verification in account registration. - Added limit for URL opener to accept only web URLs. #371 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.25.0...v1.0.0

name: v0.25.0 (2026-09-10)
body:
### Features
- Added non-destructive settings. #348  
  The change upgrades the application's user settings configuration, making the settings retrieval non-destructive, where invalid or unknown entries are unused but preserved. It replaces the old solution where the config file was duplicated into a backup file (which could be overwritten by later backups), and makes manual editing of `settings.json` safe.

### Improvements
- Migrated window state persistence to Electron's built-in API. #345 
   [Electron v44 introduced support for window state persistence](https://www.electronjs.org/blog/electron-44-0#cross-platform-window-state-persistence) and the application has been migrated to the built-in solution. 

### Fixes
- Fixed instance creator to fit narrow application window. #350 
  The instance creator of a remote instance better adapts to narrow application windows, without action buttons wrapping into multiple rows.

### Internal
- Fixed build in air-gapped environment. #349   
  [Added an upstream fix for Electron’s checksum verification](https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/releases/tag/electron-builder%4026.16.0) to work in air-gapped environments. It will allow the application to return to Flatpak.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.24.0...v0.25.0

name: v0.24.0 (2026-08-27)
body: ### Features - Added automatic Docker configuration update. #336  The Docker configuration used for local containers is now updated automatically when a new instance is created or containers are updated. ### Improvements - Updated the Docker Compose configuration template. #336 Updated the configuration template to the official configuration's newest version. Among other changes, it introduces a local MCP server and a mandatory secret key setup (used for subsystem keys, e.g. HTTP sessions and invitations). ### Fixes - Fixed support for non-patch image tags in local instance creator. #336 ### Security - Added content loading restrictions. #333 The main window session's Content Security Policy now restricts which resources can be loaded. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.23.2...v0.24.0

name: v0.23.2 (2026-06-14)
body:
### Fixes
* Fixed tab title to skip redundant information. #297
The tab title now displays only tab specific details, without Penpot suffixes. It makes for shorter tabs, resulting in more space in the tab bar, and reduces congitive load during navigation. 

### Deprecated
* Added deprecation note for elevated access option of the local instance creator. #318
Elevated access is dedicated to Linux users who manually installed Docker without granting it extended privileges via system groups. However, with [rootless Docker](https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/rootless/) being a mature solution, the setting will be removed in a future release.

### Internal
* Refactored main process' api. #308  
Unified main process' API with method-based structure and improved type safety for the events. 


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.23.1...v0.23.2

name: v0.22.0 (2025-12-16)
body: ### Features * Added instance properties editor. #257 Moved basic instance edits (label, colour) and management (deletion) to a settings modal. It reduces the risk of accidentally deleting an instance, improves accessibility with clearer UI structure, and unifies the experience between basic and local instances. ### Improvements * Added standardised installer naming. #244 Adopted standardised installer naming, using `penpot-desktop-.` pattern (e.g. `penpot-desktop-arm64.exe`). It enables linking to the right installer for your operating system using GitHub Releases `latest` tag's endpoint. * Added Flathub keywords. By @razzeee #246 Added keywords to the project's meta info for better discoverability in Flathub. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.21.0...v0.22.0

body:

- [macOS] Added signing and notarisation of the macOS builds. #230

name: v0.19.0 (2025-10-03)
body:
### Features
- Added local instance update support. #223 
  Added capability to edit a local instance’s settings and update its containers. An update will recreate the containers, and if you use the “latest” tag, the instance will upgrade to the newest available Penpot version.
  
  The creator can be opened in the edit mode through an instance panel's context menu.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cfa3820c-233a-4546-ba08-f9143d426630

### Fixes
- Fixed the local instance’s container ID in the config to match the one used for containers. #221 
- [macOS] Fixed the application to not trigger system-wide lag on macOS 26. #215 
  Following the Electron update and upstream fix, the application no longer causes lag on macOS 26 Tahoe.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.18.1...v0.19.0

name: v0.18.0 (2025-08-20)
body: ### Features - Added Penpot version support to the local instances creator #202 You can now specify the Penpot version to be used by the local instance creator. Any valid Penpot Docker repository tag is supported, however, creator suggests 10 of the most recent tags. Default version is set to the “latest” tag. ### Internal - Added automated tests #194 ### Internal **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.17.0...v0.18.0

name: v0.17.0 (2025-07-24)
body:
### Features

- Added a diagnostics dialog. #179
  Added a dialog with system and GPU information.

  You can toggle the dialog through the global menu (View > Toggle Diagnostics) or with the keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Y). The list of possible GPU property values and their meanings is available in the [Electron documentation](https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/structures/gpu-feature-status).

### Fixes

- Fixed closing of other tabs when done from the first tab. #182
  Fixed an issue where closing other tabs or tabs to the right would not work if triggered from the context menu of the first tab.

### Internal

- [Local instances] Migrated to Valkey for web socket notifications. #184
  Following changes in the official Docker Compose configuration, migrated the web socket notifications service to Valkey (from Redis).

    **Note:** This change applies only to new installations of Penpot Desktop. Existing installations will continue to use Redis until the local instance upgrade feature is available.

- Added main process debugging setup. #181
  Added `dev:debug` npm script that opens a debugging session for the main process, along with VS Code configurations for launch and attach-based debugging.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.16.0...v0.17.0

name: v0.16.0 (2025-06-25)
body:
### Features
* Added batch download of projects. #172
  Added an option to download _all_ Penpot projects as a zip archive. After selecting a download path, the files of _all_ projects will be downloaded and placed inside a zip archive, organised within a directory corresponding to each project's name. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4a5adacb-b106-4955-b0ee-fc1621ca6b0a

### Fixes
* Fixed instance creator to show only the most relevant alert. #169
  Resolves the case when the missing Docker alert is shown together with the sandbox environment alert. A sandbox environment doesn’t have access to Docker, making the instruction to install it misleading.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.15.1...v0.16.0

name: v0.15.1 (2025-05-23)
body:
### Fixes
* Fixed top bar spacing with native title bar enabled #157, #160 
  Fixed the top bar to use the space freed by the window controls when the native title bar is enabled.
* [Linux] Fixed the app to run with Gnome #158 
  Version 36 of Electron introduced a breaking change (inherited from its Chromium update) by setting GTK version 4 as the default. This fix implements a workaround to use the GTK v3.
  Refs.: [Electron docs](https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/breaking-changes#changed-gtk-4-is-default-when-running-gnome), [Electron #46538](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/46538)

name: v0.14.0 (2025-05-09)
body:
### Features
- Added local instance creator.
   ⚠️ This feature is experimental. For production-critical work, please use [the manual setup guide](https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/wiki/Self%E2%80%90hosting/#manual-setup).

  📢 Unfortunately, I’m unable to test this feature on Windows. I would appreciate any reports on if and how it's working on this operating system.  

  Added an automated setup for local Penpot installation, based on the official Docker method for self-hosting Penpot.  After you fill a short form, with an instance label and your preferences regarding analytics, Penpot Desktop will set up a local instance of Penpot on your machine. Once the instance is up and running, you will see it available in the app, communicated through an in-app notification and reflected in the user interface.
  
  For full documentation on the local instance creator, please refer to [the Selfhost documentation entry](https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/wiki/Self%E2%80%90hosting#instance-creator).

[penpot-desktop-local-instance-creator-demo-mac.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6c9c2fd-8204-45cf-af61-d0f6711c7191)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.13.1...v0.14.0

name: v0.13.1 (2025-05-01)
body:
### Fixes
- Fixed opaque instance colour to accept a float value for alpha. #135 
  The app would report an invalid instance `color` setting if the alpha was set to `1.00`. This fix updates the validation of the instance's `color` property to accept a float value for the alpha channel for 100% opacity.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.13.0...v0.13.1

name: v0.13.0 (2025-04-26)
body:
### Features
* [BREAKING CHANGE] Added `color` setting validation. #126
  Added `color` setting validation to ensure correct theme application and fixed tabs' background with the default instance colour. In addition to the general validity rules of the HSLA colour format, it checks for quirks of the colour picker that the app is using.

  #### Who is affected?
  ⚠️ If you manually edited a colour in the settings file and a `color` value has an incompatible format, you should receive an error report on launch. The settings won't be lost, they will be backed up and available for you to reapply - it is detailed in the error report.

  🟢 If you haven't manually changed a `color` setting from the default value or used only the settings panel to set your instances' colours, you shouldn’t be affected. Although the old default value for the `color` setting was invalid, the app will update it with the new, valid, default value before validating the format.

### Fixes
* Fixed theme to set without media change on initialisation. #129
  The fix addresses a situation where a theme would not be completely set in the application, resulting in it mixing with another theme’s style. For example, the light theme’s text colour being used in the dark theme.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.12.1...v0.13.0

name: v0.12.1 (2025-04-12)
body:
### Fixes
- Fixed a colourless tab to have active and hover states.
- Fixed top bar spacing. 
  Fixed positioning of elements in the top bar. “Add/New tab” button now docks next to the window controls on Linux and Windows. On macOS, controls and tabs now fill the space of the traffic lights while in full-screen mode.
- Fixed in-app navigation to use the active tab’s instance. 
  Fixed in-app tab navigation (e.g. opening a resource in a new tab) to use the active tab’s instance. It resolves the situation when a new tab would be opened outside the original tab’s instance and without necessary context, e.g. opening a project preview in an instance where it doesn’t exist.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.12.0...v0.12.1

name: v0.12.0 (2025-04-05)
body:
### Features

- Added new user interface (UI) design.
   The new UI is unified and seamlessly integrates with the look of the Penpot app while maintaining familiarity. It’s based on the concept by @mayrinck and Penpot’s official design system, Pencil.

  The most notable changes are:
  * Colour palette(s) are unified across UI elements.
  * Colour coding is consistent between themes.
  * A tab's background colour is tinted with its instance's assigned colour.
  * The tab opening menu features colour coding.

  ![A split image of the Penpot Desktop application in light and dark theme.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fcc581d5-dbfa-4a32-8026-dd3b5da769a4)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0

name: v0.11.0 (2025-02-24)
body:
### Features
- Added support for multiple instances.
    You can now open and manage multiple Penpot instances at the same time, each in its own color-coded tab for easy identification.
    - A new option in the context menu of the "Add Tab" button allows you to quickly open a specific instance.
    - Instances with the same origin are treated as separate, persistent sessions, allowing you to log in to different accounts (e.g., work, personal).
    - Instance management is accessible through the app's settings, where you can also set the default instance via the context menu for the instance entry.

[penpot-desktop-multiple-instances-demo.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e2883b60-4582-4253-bfeb-24de94e01d59)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

name: v0.10.0 (2025-01-26)
body:
### Features
- [BREAKING CHANGE] Added file based settings.
  Added file based configuration system for settings. Now you can move or sync Penpot Desktop’s settings between devices, share it with a team, or include in a back-up.
  
  Settings are held in a human-readable, `settings.json` file. The directory with an application's user files is specific to an operating system and its configuration, but you can read about the default setup in [Electron's documentation](https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/app#appgetpathname) - see `userData` path for `app.getPath` method.

  ⚠️ It is a breaking change. After the upgrade, the settings will have default values and you will need to set them back to the preferred ones.

### Fixes
- [Flathub] Fixed file selector dialog to use portals. By @Beryesa.
  Electron v34 restored portals for file selector dialog. The Flathub version of Penpot Desktop will no longer require access to `Downloads` and `Documents` directories.

### Internal
- Added dependencies update automation.
  Configured Dependabot for automatic dependency updates. Suggested in #54.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0

name: v0.9.0 (2025-01-12)
body: ### Features - Added the new settings side bar. Added a new side bar. It starts with hosting the settings available so far. In the future, it will provide space for more controls of dynamic aspects of the app. ### Fixes - Fixed the window controls to match preferred colour scheme, with the app’s theme colours. - [Linux] Fixed the window to utilise a single set of controls - the native ones. - [macOS] Fixed the installer to show the project’s license. ### Improvements - Updated Electron to the latest version. ### Internal - Updated development dependencies. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0

name: v0.8.0 (2024-12-29)
body:
### Features

- Added light/dark mode support.  
  Added the Theme setting that determines preferred user interface's colour scheme.
  
  Available options are:
    - Light - sets UI to the light theme,
    - Dark - sets UI to the dark theme,
    - System - sets UI to follow an operating system's theme,
    - Penpot - sets UI to follow a theme of the Penpot app in the active tab.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/12bf7122-2aee-416b-bfd7-896e2dd5d694

### Internal

- Moved the code base to ES Modules.
- Added linting and formatting for code and commit messages.
  Added formatting for code and linting for code and commit messages. Formatting and lint issues are tested during commit and CI runs.    

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0

name: v0.7.0 (2024-12-15)
body:
### Features - Added a tab management menu.  Added a context menu for a tab item. It gives you an option to reload or duplicate a tab, or batch close [other, right, left] tabs in relation to the targeted one.
### Improvements - Added Flathub (Flatpak) support. By @Beryesa 🎉 Penpot Desktop is now available on [the Flathub app store](https://flathub.org/apps/com.authormore.penpotdesktop). ### Internal - Cleaned up dependencies.  - Refactored styling to CSS, removed Sass. - Removed unused dependencies. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0

name: v0.6.0 (2024-12-04)
body:
### Features
- Added navigation requests action prompt
  Added a question system dialog for navigation requests that can't be resolved based on the lists of allowed origins and URLs. It lets the user decide how a link that can't be predefined should be handled (e.g. links in plug-ins and custom OpenID providers #31), with options to cancel, open, or open in a browser (depending on the request).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/author-more/penpot-desktop/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0

name: v0.5.0 (2024-12-02)
body:
### Features
- Added dynamic instance support.
  The Penpot instance, after set in the settings, updates without the need to reload or restart the app. 

### Fixes
- Fixed OpenID login buttons (Login with Google/GitHub/GitLab) to trigger a login flow.

### Internal
